meanings.ex: His lifelong fascination with ancient languages led him to decipher several lost scripts.

meanings.ex: Hunting swift game with a spear or bow requires extraordinary precision and patience, even under ideal conditions.
meanings.tr: 빠른 사냥감을 창이나 활로 사냥하는 것은 이상적인 조건에서도 탁월한 정확성과 인내심을 요구한다.

meanings.ex: Fishermen would spear fish from the riverbank using long, sharpened poles.

meanings.ex: Passengers were warmly welcomed back aboard the cruise liner for another season of voyage.
meanings.tr: 승객들은 또 다른 항해 시즌을 위해 크루즈 선에 다시 탑승하며 따뜻한 환영을 받았다.

meanings.ex: Medieval monks painstakingly copied manuscripts, thereby preserving classical knowledge for future generations.
meanings.tr: 중세 수도승들은 고전 지식을 후세를 위해 보존하기 위해 원고를 공들여 필사했다.

meanings.ex: The ancient battlefield was eventually transformed into a memorial park honoring those who had perished.
meanings.tr: 그 고대 전쟁터는 결국 전사자들을 기리는 추모 공원으로 변모했다.

meanings.ex: The courtroom became a battlefield in which competing ideologies clashed over constitutional interpretation.

meanings.ex: Most natural landscapes in industrialized nations have been replaced by artificial environments defined by mass production and repetition.
meanings.tr: 산업화된 국가들의 대부분의 자연 경관은 대량 생산과 반복으로 규정되는 인공적 환경으로 대체되었다.

meanings.ex: The tedious repetition of identical tasks saps workers' creativity and motivation over time.
meanings.tr: 동일한 작업의 지루한 반복은 시간이 지남에 따라 근로자의 창의성과 동기를 고갈시킨다.

meanings.ex: Only through sustained inquiry will researchers arrive at a substantive understanding of the concept's full complexity.
meanings.tr: 지속적인 탐구를 통해서만 연구자들은 그 개념의 완전한 복잡성에 대한 실질적인 이해에 도달할 것이다.

meanings.ex: The treaty negotiations produced no substantive agreement on the most contentious environmental clauses.
meanings.tr: 조약 협상은 가장 논란이 많은 환경 조항에 대해 어떠한 실질적인 합의도 도출하지 못했다.

meanings.ex: Medieval etiquette manuals were primarily written for the children of aristocrats who needed to learn proper conduct at court.

meanings.ex: Prehistoric human activity drove many large mammals to extinction long before modern industrial practices began.
meanings.tr: 선사시대 인간의 활동은 현대 산업 관행이 시작되기 훨씬 전에 많은 대형 포유동물을 멸종으로 몰아갔다.

meanings.ex: Romantics held the fond belief that untamed wilderness existed entirely beyond the reach of human control.

meanings.ex: Her fond assumption that negotiations would succeed quickly proved to be entirely mistaken.
meanings.tr: 협상이 빨리 성공할 것이라는 그녀의 지나치게 낙관적인 가정은 완전히 틀린 것으로 판명됐다.

meanings.ex: Wildlife managers must weigh the negative effects of a predator's predation on endangered prey species against broader ecological benefits.
meanings.tr: 야생동물 관리자들은 포식자의 포식이 멸종위기 먹이 종에 미치는 부정적 영향을 더 넓은 생태적 이점과 비교 검토해야 한다.

meanings.ex: Without a formal mechanism that forbids educators from benchmarking against peers, professional growth stagnates.

meanings.ex: The sheer complexity of the task forbids any quick or simplistic solution.

meanings.ex: Even when someone conceals their true feelings, subtle signs of betrayal can seep through unconscious gestures and expressions.

meanings.ex: Authoritarian regimes frequently suppress dissent by controlling access to information and restricting civil liberties.

meanings.ex: The athlete adhered to a strict training regime that left little time for social activities.

meanings.ex: There was an intangible tension in the room that made everyone reluctant to speak candidly.

meanings.ex: She preferred to steam vegetables lightly rather than boil them, thereby preserving their nutritional value.

meanings.ex: Creative work serves as a means by which individuals actualize their inner potential and express it in tangible form.

meanings.ex: Retailers frequently boost sales by offering accompanying services such as professional installation and ongoing maintenance.

meanings.ex: Attendance at the supplementary seminar was described as optional, though students who skipped it often struggled with assessments.

meanings.ex: It seems entirely natural for a restaurant server to hand a new customer a menu upon their arrival.

meanings.ex: All user data is encrypted before being transmitted to the company's secure cloud server.

meanings.ex: Since Plato, rationalist philosophy has maintained that reason can extract genuine knowledge from raw experience.

meanings.ex: The researcher cited a lengthy extract from the original manuscript to support her argument.

meanings.ex: Students who develop strong analytical skills tend to fare significantly better in competitive academic environments.
meanings.tr: 강한 분석 능력을 개발한 학생들은 경쟁적인 학문적 환경에서 훨씬 더 잘 해나가는 경향이 있다.

meanings.ex: Airlines impose strict limits on luggage weight to manage fuel efficiency and ensure the safety of each flight.
meanings.tr: 항공사들은 연료 효율성을 관리하고 각 비행의 안전을 보장하기 위해 수하물 무게에 엄격한 제한을 부과한다.

meanings.ex: Many citizens lamented that their peers had grown increasingly atomized and irresponsible in their attitude toward the common good.
meanings.tr: 많은 시민들은 자신의 동료들이 공동선에 대한 태도에서 점점 더 고립되고 무책임해졌다고 한탄했다.
